sectors.name: Technology

US semiconductor and hardware names face inventory correction risk as AI capex digestion slows, favoring selective longs over broad exposure.

Trim US-linked semis (SWKS, UVCR) into strength—global cycle is fading. Rotate into BELI post-surge only on pullback; hold DELL for AI server upside.

sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech
themes: US utility-scale and storage demand is structurally rising due to AI data-center power contracts, benefiting VST and CEG regardless of solar-policy swings.
Global solar module oversupply is forcing margin consolidation, favoring vertically integrated players (RUN, ARRY) over pure manufacturers, a durable shakeout driver.
Indonesia's renewables growth hinges on PLN off-take reforms and carbon-market monetization; TOBA's upside depends on regulatory execution, not global price trends.
sectors.ai: Buy selective US renewables (RUN, ARRY, SEDG) and Korean solar (051910, 373220) on momentum, but trim Indonesia-exposed names (TOBA) as local policy remains slow. Pair long VST/CEG for stable power demand against volatile equipment makers. Rotate profits into names with confirmed order books; avoid chasing +7% spikes without volume confirmation.

sectors.name: Consumer & FMCG
themes: Palm-oil upstream integration is re-rating FMCG names like BWPT (+21%) as CPO prices stay elevated, giving cost advantage to self-supplied consumer goods makers.
Rural consumption recovery is driving outsized gains in mid-cap staples (SSMS, GZCO, LUCY) as distribution networks expand beyond Java into tier-3/4 markets.
Foreign and domestic liquidity rotation into small-cap consumer names (BTEK, FLMC, KAQI) reflects risk-on appetite for high-beta stories, but sustainability hinges on earnings delivery next quarter.
sectors.ai: Buy selective small/mid-cap consumer names with confirmed volume breakouts (BWPT, SSMS, GZCO) and pair with liquid large-cap staples for downside protection. Momentum is broad but not euphoric—add on dips, avoid chasing +20% spikes without follow-through. Rotate into palm-oil-linked FMCG (BWPT) and regional snack/dairy plays (SSMS, GZCO) as rupiah stability supports input costs.

sectors.name: Logistics
themes: Indonesia's logistics sector is structurally supported by the government's downstreaming push, which raises bulk cargo and port throughput volumes independent of global trade cycles.

Fuel subsidy reforms and infrastructure completion (toll roads, ports) lower operating costs for domestic trucking and shipping firms, widening margins for SMDR and TMAS over the medium term.
sectors.ai: Accumulate Indonesian logistics names on pullbacks, led by SAFE, SAPX, and TRUK, as domestic volume growth outpaces global weakness. Rotate out of US-exposed peers and into pure-play ID operators benefiting from port congestion and e-commerce last-mile demand. Watch SMDR and GIAA for follow-through; trim LAJU on speculative froth.

sectors.name: Crypto & Digital Assets
themes: Layer-2 and interoperability tokens (ARB, LIT) are re-rating on sustained Ethereum ecosystem activity, a structural shift toward cheaper execution rails that outlasts any single catalyst.
Indonesian crypto adoption is increasingly driven by regulated exchange listings and local payment integrations, making token liquidity and compliance status a durable filter for outperformance.
Altcoin breadth, led by ADA and SUI, is expanding as institutional custody rails mature in Asia, rewarding projects with clear developer roadmaps over meme-driven volatility.
sectors.ai: Buy selective momentum: ARB (+14%) and LIT (+11%) lead on real volume, not noise—rotate into SUI and ADA for laggard upside as risk appetite broadens. Indonesia's retail crypto flow is tracking global beta, so overweight liquid majors over microcaps. Trim JST and ASTER into strength; their gains lack follow-through. Position for a 2-3 week continuation, not a daily scalp.
